name: Emotion-Aware AIoT
subtitle: Edge-AI classroom intelligence
summary: A Raspberry Pi classroom system combining attendance, experimental facial-expression analysis, video streaming, and a web dashboard.
overview: The Emotion-Aware IoT Classroom Attendance System connects a camera and edge computer-vision pipeline to a FastAPI backend, SQLite storage, and a monitoring dashboard. It uses LBPH for face recognition and FER+ through ONNX Runtime for experimental facial-expression estimation.
current_state: The handoff reports an integrated backend, video streaming, recognition, expression inference, and dashboard, with Raspberry Pi deployment work underway. The owner reports that the system works partially; accuracy, tracking, and performance still need improvement.
highlights: Python, FastAPI, OpenCV, MediaPipe, ONNX Runtime, and SQLite.
Raspberry Pi 5 and a USB camera, with MJPEG video streaming.
Ongoing work on multi-person tracking, recognition accuracy, and temporal analysis.
next_focus: Benchmark the existing implementation under realistic classroom conditions. Attendance, facial expression, and engagement are different signals; expression predictions do not establish a student’s internal emotional state.
sources: Earlier classroom source and partial-functionality update
